'''Shan'dira''' was a young [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] from the [[Dira Clan]]. She attempted to seek passage off-world with a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who were visiting [[Kala'uun/Legends|Kala'uun]].
